title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with edit permission for the container label of a pending external prompt…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with edit permission on the container label of a pending external prompt can access the external prompt link via the REST API. This link allows the user to view and resolve the associated approval, bypassing intended approval scope restrictions. The vulnerability arises because the approval detail REST API exposes the external prompt link in responses beyond the assigned approval scope.
